meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Maximum-saturation research orchestration: ALWAYS proposes the final materials first (PDF+DOCX default), then parallel explore+librarian swarms across codebase, web, official docs, and OSS repos — max-roster teammode when the harness has it — with live journaling, a recursive EXPAND loop driven by leads workers return in message text, empirical verification by running code, and a cited synthesis with charts/Mermaid/assets behind a mandatory visual-QA gate. ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user demand for research — the word 'ulw-research' ('/ulw-research', '$ulw-research'), any 'ulw' research wording, 'ultradebate' or 'hyperdebate' research requests, or an explicit request for research / deep research / an ultra-precise investigation, in any language. Never self-activates for ordinary questions, debugging, or implementation context-gathering. While active it overrides exploration-bounding defaults: exhaustive coverage is the goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发起深度研究,并联探索多源资料并输出带引证结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要快速获取跨多源、带验证的深度研究报告
copy.tagline_en: Kick off deep research, explore multiple sources in parallel and deliver cited findings
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need fast, multi-source, verified deep-dive reports

howto.what: 启动后,Claude 会先询问交付格式(默认 PDF+DOCX),再派出多路并行研究小组,查代码库、网页、官方文档和开源仓库;记录过程,用跑代码验证有争议的说法,最后给出带引用、图表和 Mermaid 图的综合报告,产出前先做视觉质检。
howto.when: 仅当用户明确要求研究时触发:说出“ulw-research”或“ulw”类研究措辞、要求“deep research/超精确调查”等;普通提问、调试或收集上下文不触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 深度调研一下 React 19 的并发特性
say.note: 会触发多路并行检索并产出带引用的综合报告。

say.text: 来一场 hyperdebate 研究,检验“某框架更快”这个说法
say.note: 会有至少两个批判视角轮番攻击该说法。

howto.what_en: Research mode: proposes format first (PDF+DOCX default); runs explore+librarian teams over codebase, web, docs, OSS repos; journals live; verifies claims by running code; delivers cited synthesis with charts/Mermaid after a visual-QA gate.
howto.when_en: Triggers only on explicit research demands: 'ulw-research', 'ulw' research wording, or explicit deep/ultra-precise research requests, in any language. Never for ordinary questions, debugging, or context-gathering.

say_en.text: Use ulw-research for a deep dive into React 19's concurrency features.
say_en.note: Parallel teams fan out; you get a cited synthesis.

say_en.text: /ulw-research: compare the official docs and source of PostgreSQL vs MySQL.
say_en.note: Format is proposed first, then teams are dispatched.

say_en.text: Run a hyperdebate research round to test the claim that framework X is faster.
say_en.note: At least two attacking perspectives challenge the claim.
